chunks.section_title: Walk 1: The Birthplace of the City
chunks.summary: Walk through Île de la Cité — the Celtic and Roman origins of Paris, Notre-Dame, Sainte-Chapelle, Conciergerie, Memorial to the Deported.
Walk through the Louvre, Tuileries, and Palais Royal — royal Paris and the grand museum complex.
Walk through Les Halles and surroundings — the former central market, Saint-Eustache, Bourse de Commerce, Châtelet.
Walk through the Beaubourg area — Pompidou Centre, Saint-Merry, Nicolas Flamel's house, Tour Saint-Jacques.
Walk through the Marais — Place des Vosges, Hôtel de Sully, Carnavalet, Renaissance hôtels particuliers.
Walk through the Marais around Saint-Paul and the Jewish quarter — rue des Rosiers, Hôtel de Sens.
Walk through the Bastille and Faubourg Saint-Antoine — Opéra Bastille, artisan courtyards, Promenade Plantée.

chunks.section_title: Walk 8: Home of the Famous Dead
chunks.summary: Walk through Père Lachaise Cemetery — graves of Chopin, Oscar Wilde, Jim Morrison, Edith Piaf, the Communards' Wall.
Walk through Île Saint-Louis — the aristocratic 17th-century island, Hôtel Lambert, Church of Saint-Louis-en-l'Île, Berthillon.
Walk through the Madeleine district — the Madeleine church, Fauchon, Hédiard, Place Vendôme, Rue Saint-Honoré.
Walk through Montmartre — Sacré-Cœur, Place du Tertre, Le Bateau-Lavoir, the last remaining vineyard, Moulin de la Galette.

chunks.section_title: Walk 12: How the Other Half Live
chunks.summary: Walk through the Monceau district and Plaine Monceau — the grand 19th-century mansions of the Parisian haute bourgeoisie.

chunks.section_title: Walk 13: The Phantom of the Opera
chunks.summary: Walk around the Opéra Garnier — Haussmann's grands boulevards, Galeries Lafayette, Printemps, covered passages.
Walk through the 8th arrondissement's luxury district — Avenue Montaigne, Avenue George-V, couture houses, Champs-Élysées, Arc de Triomphe.
Walk along the Seine bridges — Pont Neuf, Pont des Arts, Pont Royal, Pont Alexandre III, the river's architectural history.
Walk through Les Invalides — Napoleon's Tomb, Army Museum, École Militaire, Champ-de-Mars.

chunks.section_title: Walk 17: The Iron Lady of Paris
chunks.summary: Walk around the Eiffel Tower — construction history, Trocadéro, Pont d'Iéna, Palais de Chaillot.

chunks.section_title: Walk 18: Art Nouveau to Art Deco
chunks.summary: Walk through the 16th arrondissement — Castel Béranger, Guimard's Art Nouveau buildings, Mallet-Stevens Art Deco street.
Walk through Saint-Sulpice and the Luxembourg Garden — the church, the Paris Meridian (rose line), gardens, Odéon theatre.

chunks.section_title: Walk 20: From Romans to the Revolution
chunks.summary: Walk through the Latin Quarter — Arènes de Lutèce, Cluny Museum, Sorbonne, Panthéon, Saint-Étienne-du-Mont.

chunks.section_title: Walk 21: Down and Out in Paris
chunks.summary: Walk through the Mouffetard district — rue Mouffetard market, Place de la Contrescarpe, Hemingway and Orwell territory.
Walk through Saint-Germain-des-Prés and nearby — the abbey church, Café de Flore, Les Deux Magots, Odéon, Institut de France.
Walk to the Catacombs and Montparnasse — the underground ossuary, Montparnasse Cemetery, the old artist quarter.
Walk through the 9th arrondissement artist quarter — Musée Gustave Moreau, Musée de la Vie Romantique, Nouvelle Athènes, Square d'Orléans.
